visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a large stage with a heavy red velvet curtain backdrop. A woman in a red blazer, a man in black overalls, and a woman in a white ruffled top stand together. The woman in red holds a red microphone. (2) Close-up interview shot showing the man in black overalls and the woman in a white top. A professional broadcast camera and multiple microphones are positioned in front of them. The background shows theater seating and the stage logo. (3) The man and woman are on stage again, gesturing energetically while speaking into microphones. The lighting is bright and warm. (4) The perspective shifts to a large LED screen on stage displaying a man in a grey suit speaking. A crowd of people is visible in the background behind the screen. (5) Back to the live stage, the two main hosts are laughing and interacting. The man points towards the audience while the woman smiles. (6) A camera pans across a large crowd of press photographers and media personnel with various cameras and microphones, indicating a high-profile event. (7) A sequence of clips plays on the large stage screen, showing various individuals in emotional states, including close-ups of faces with tearful expressions and intense dramatic acting. (8) On-screen clips continue, showing a physical scene where a woman pushes a man on a couch, followed by a woman holding a small gold trophy while speaking. (9) The man in black overalls is shown in a tight close-up, surrounded by a dense cluster of news microphones with various channel logos, being interviewed. (10) The video concludes with a massive wide shot of the entire group of participants, judges, and crew on stage, all smiling and giving a thumbs-up to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male vocal narration begins immediately over a fast-paced electronic pop track with a strong synth bass. The speaker's tone is extremely bright and enthusiastic. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator mentions his university, followed by a brief clip of a second male voice with moderate reverb from a stage microphone. (3) Laughter and high-pitched vocal chatter from the female co-host are mixed in as the BGM continues its steady 4/4 rhythm. (4) The BGM shifts to a more sentimental, acoustic piano texture as the narration describes emotional scenes. Sound bites of crying and dramatic shouting from the contestants are layered into the master track. (5) A rhythmic 'ding' sound effect highlights a variety-show text appearing on screen. The narrator's speech rate remains high and energetic. (6) The video concludes with a collective cheer and loud applause from a crowd, which swells in volume alongside a final musical crescendo and a concluding 'pop' sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Intro -> Event Highlights -> Dramatic Montage -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional announcement for a new television drama talent show called '戲戲品味'. It combines personal vlog-style narration with high-production event footage and emotional highlight reels to generate excitement and encourage viewers to watch the broadcast on the CTI Television network.
